request: Read-only Vault Docker status and report bounded nonsecret metadata to existing Issue10; no secret or container mutation.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
state=$(docker ps -a --filter name=libral-vault --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Image}}' | head -n 3)
if [ -z "$state" ]; then state=NOT_FOUND; fi
if docker container inspect libral-vault >/dev/null 2>&1; then health=$(docker inspect libral-vault --format '{{.State.Status}}|{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}'); else health=NOT_FOUND; fi
body=$(printf 'VAULT_HOST_READBACK\ncontainer=%s\nstate_health=%s\n' "$state" "$health")
printf '%s\n' "$body"
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'
